changes.evidence: The final Brand Corporation stage records a return that never happens on screen, so it reads as if he left Fisk's Empire. After his mutation (episode 19, S2 ep5) he becomes the Kingpin's lieutenant and chief scientist (episode 35, S3 ep8). He recreates the super-soldier serum for the Kingpin (episode 47, S4 ep2) and is still at the Kingpin's side in the Six Forgotten Warriors arc (episode 57). Marvel Database lists Brand Corporation ownership as 'formerly'. The owner has already settled this in morning_calls.json ('Herbert Landon: drop the final Brand Corporation stage (no return shown)'), but the record still has the stage. No left title is involved.
